results.title: Why are the images in my tickets broken? – Zendesk help
results.content: June 16, 2023 - When the image is broken, that means that it is not hosted in the agent interface. The agent interface attempts to load the image from the source. Zendesk doesn't save and host images locally when they are copied and pasted from another source

results.title: Zendesk was built for a world that no longer exists. Customer support issues have always been treated like rows in a to-do list, and the system rewards teams for closing them as quickly as… | Deepak Singla
results.content: Zendesk was built for a world that no longer exists. Customer support issues have always been treated like rows in a to-do list, and the system rewards teams for closing them as quickly as possible. But does closing tickets really solve customer problems? Or does it just push issues under the rug? I had a very interesting discussion with the Head of Product for a $3b company where she mentioned how frustrating and time consuming it is to get insights from customer interactions. Here’s the problem: every customer interaction is treated like an isolated “ticket.” No context from past conversations. No understanding of the customer’s journey. Just a one-dimensional task to be resolved. It’s a system designed for quick fixes, not for building meaningful relationships with customers. This [...] were constructed, which are centered on rigid platforms and sequential processes that break down the instant that customer behaviour changes. Which leads to a major impact on margins eaten by penalties, slow responses that drive customers away, teams burning out and, sometimes, leaving faster than they can be replaced. And yet, this is happening while layers of technology are being added everyday. When the conversation turns to tools, people start listing them proudly, and then you hear the frustration between the lines. Too many platforms, none adapting fast enough, each one talking past the other, with all dashboards showing volume rather than value. Instead of replacing your helpdesk, #Sferal AI connects to an intelligent layer that reads, understands, and routes requests in real time. [...] Like most CRMs, Zendesk is an online customer support platform that brings all your customer interactions, from email and chat to phone, social media, and messaging apps into one simple workspace. As a business owner, how do you juggle between answering customer inquiries  like flight delays, reschedules, cancellations, or even missing luggage ,without missing a single message or feeling overwhelmed? Zendesk makes that easy by helping you track and resolve every customer question, request, or complaint in one organized place. It’s more than a helpdesk, it’s a complete customer experience platform that makes communication seamless and support effortless.
